card.name: Area and distance unit conversions
card.fires_on: The word sq or square, or a digit, inside a geographic size or distance figure that gives a metric and imperial pair, such as miles with km. It sits just before the unit finishes.

modes.label: Area unit word
modes.description: The word sq or square after an area number, before km or mi.
modes.example: The park covers an area of 1,148<< sq>> km.

modes.label: Digit in converted distance
modes.description: A digit inside a kilometer figure given in brackets after miles.
modes.example: is 30 miles (4<<8>> km) northwest of Downtown San Antonio.
